data.one_liner: Mathematical 2D array functions and manipulations inspired by NumPy
data.what_it_does: Provides mathematical operations for 2D arrays in Dart such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, transposition, and slicing. It includes support for vectorised operations, matrix reshaping, and finding minimum or maximum values.
use_when: You need NumPy-like matrix operations in Dart
You are working with 2D lists and need common mathematical manipulations like dot products or transpositions
avoid_when: You need high-performance native numerical computing (consider FFI bindings instead)
strengths: Simple and easy-to-use API inspired by NumPy
Supports a wide range of matrix operations including dot product, slicing, and reshaping
weaknesses: Pure Dart implementation may lack the native performance of C-based matrix libraries for massive datasets
